interface.longDescription:
Rule Masters is a card battle game where you decide what your cards do. There's no rules text on the cards: you propose an effect, name your price, and see if your opponent agrees.

If they don't, they call the Arbiter. It rules on Objections, decides how fights turn out, and answers questions about the game. Describe what's happening or show it a photo of the cards.
defaultPrompt: Resolve combat: Shark Boxer attacks Penguin Police at the Beach.
Objection! My opponent activated Cheese Wizard to turn my Shark Boxer into a wheel of cheese until end of turn.
What's the difference between Invoking and Binding a card?

name: rule-masters-arbiter
description: The judge for Rule Masters. Bring it a fight, an Objection, or a question about the rules.
